rmhstudiosassist-desc: Adds "Edit with AI" to the editor: describe the page and DeepSeek writes it, through rmhstudios.com.
rmhstudiosassist-placeholder-new: Describe the page: what it covers, the sections you want, facts to include and the tone. For example: "A guide to Balatro. Sections: rules, scoring, jokers, tips for beginners."
rmhstudiosassist-placeholder-edit: Say what to change. For example: "Add a section on scoring" or "Rewrite the introduction in two sentences".
rmhstudiosassist-note: DeepSeek writes the page into the edit box below. Nothing is saved until you press Save changes, so read it first: the assistant leaves [placeholders] where it lacks a fact.
rmhstudiosassist-done: Done. Read the page, fix anything wrong, then save.
rmhstudiosassist-error-signin: Your rmhstudios.com session has ended, so the assistant cannot run.
rmhstudiosassist-error-budget: You have used this month's AI allowance on rmhstudios.com.
rmhstudiosassist-error-forbidden: The assistant is not available to this account.
rmhstudiosassist-error-rate: Too many requests. Wait a minute, then try again.
rmhstudiosassist-error-offline: The assistant is offline right now.
rmhstudiosassist-error-empty: The assistant wrote nothing. Try again.
rmhstudiosassist-error-failed: The assistant stopped before it finished. Try again.
